bore_diameter = 40.0

bolt_circle_diameter = 95.0
thickness = 14.0
bolt_count = 6

# Base flange plate
result = Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=thickness)

# Central through bore
cut_height = thickness + 2.0
result -= Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2, height=cut_height)

# Six equally spaced through bolt holes on the 95 mm PCD

# Circular pipe flange parameters (mm)

bore_diameter = 40.0
plate_thickness = 14.0

bolt_circle_diameter = 95.0

    Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=plate_thickness)

    Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2, height=plate_thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
